'''Carlys Ankerin''' is a lesser noble from [[Andor]] and has the sigil of a pair of White Leopards.

==Appearance==
Carlys has gray curled hair.

== Activities ==
Usually support is thrown behind [[Elenia Sarand]]'s claim to the [[Lion Throne]] but the House's banners were seen in [[Arymilla Marne]] camp outside [[Caemlyn]].
